content.text: Found a real implementation bug — at local ingress I only checked the *selected* claim, but the protocol requires **every** nonanonymous From **and** any PPI to resolve to an allowed+hosted identity. Let me fix `select_identity`:

arguments.command:
cd /workspace && python3 - << 'PYEOF'
src = open("submission/gateway.py").read()
old = '''    if kind == "local":
        acct = accounts.get(ingress.get("subject"))
        if acct is None:
            raise UnauthErr()
        primary, allowed = acct
        if p.ppi_norm is not None:
            selected = _resolve_local(p.ppi_norm, allowed, local_domains, alias)
        elif not p.from_anon:
            selected = _resolve_local(p.from_norm, allowed, local_domains, alias)
        else:
            selected = primary
        if selected not in allowed:
            raise IdentErr()
        if _domain(selected) not in local_domains:
            raise IdentErr()
        return "local", selected'''
new = '''    if kind == "local":
        acct = accounts.get(ingress.get("subject"))
        if acct is None:
            raise UnauthErr()
        primary, allowed = acct
        # Every nonanonymous From and any PPI must resolve to an allowed
        # account identity whose canonical domain is hosted here.
        if not p.from_anon:
            _resolve_local(p.from_norm, allowed, local_domains, alias)
        if p.ppi_norm is not None:
            selected = _resolve_local(p.ppi_norm, allowed, local_domains, alias)
        elif not p.from_anon:
            selected = alias[p.from_norm]
        else:
            selected = primary
        # The selected identity must also be hosted and allowed.
        if selected not in allowed:
            raise IdentErr()
        if _domain(selected) not in local_domains:
            raise IdentErr()
        return "local", selected'''
assert old in src
src = src.replace(old, new)
open("submission/gateway.py","w").write(src)

t = open("tmp/tests4.py").read()
t = t.replace('check("pai comma in brackets ok", run(batch([job(raw=req(extra=("P-Asserted-Identity: <sip:ember@studio.test,x>",)), ingress=P, gw="inside")]))[0], rej("identity"))',
              'check("pai comma in brackets ok", run(batch([job(raw=req(extra=("P-Asserted-Identity: <sip:ember@studio.test,x>",)), ingress=P, gw="inside")]))[0], rej("syntax"))')
t = t.replace('}))["results"][0]["identity"]', '}))[0]["identity"]')
open("tmp/tests4.py","w").write(t)
PYEOF
python3 tmp/tests4.py
